description: This file defines a class 'Compare' containing static methods for engineering calculations, specifically implementing Excel functions DELTA and GESTEP. These functions test the equality of two values and compare a number against a step threshold, respectively. The class also includes utility usage and handles array arguments.

classes.name: Compare
classes.description: A class providing static methods for engineering comparison functions DELTA and GESTEP, mimicking Excel behavior and supporting array inputs.

methods.name: DELTA
methods.description: Tests whether two values are equal, returning 1 if they are (within a tiny tolerance), and 0 otherwise. Supports array inputs.

methods.name: GESTEP
methods.description: Checks if a number is greater than or equal to a step threshold, returning 1 if true, 0 otherwise. Supports array inputs.
